items.clause: 5.6: height of living rooms floor to ceiling at least 2.5 m; at least 2.7 m where mean July temperature is 21 C or more; internal corridors and utility rooms may be 2.1 m
items.paraphrase: Living rooms must be at least 2.5 m high, 2.7 m in hot regions; corridors and service rooms inside flats may drop to 2.1 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3884013503861753171 (actualised text with Amendment 1, status active)

items.clause: 6.2.2: clear width of room doors at least 0.9 m in new build (Amendment 3: 0.8 m for major repair or reconstruction); deep openings over 1.0 m need 1.2 m
items.paraphrase: Door clear width at least 0.9 m in new buildings, relaxed to 0.8 m when refurbishing; openings deeper than 1 m need 1.2 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3790590059153983464 (actualised text with Amendments 1-2 and text of Amendment 3)

items.clause: 6.2.2: diameter of zone for independent wheelchair turning at least 1.5 m
items.paraphrase: A wheelchair user needs a turning zone of at least 1.5 m diameter.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3790590059153983464 (Amendment 3 restates 6.2.2 with the same 1.5 m)

items.clause: 5.3.1 (Amendment 3): slope of open ramps not more than 8 percent (1:12); single rise max 0.8 m with 1.5 m landings
items.paraphrase: Open ramps may be at most 8 percent (1:12) steep, with lower slopes required for larger rises per the annex table.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3790590059153983464; max for the outdoor ramps; practical slope depends on rise per annex D (1:20 for 0.5 m rise)

items.clause: 5.7: corridor in residential buildings between stairs or from a corridor end to a stair, and a gallery, at least 1.8 m wide; 5.22 (Amendment 1) sets 1.5 m only for corridors inside a flat leading to living rooms
items.paraphrase: Common corridors and galleries of apartment buildings are at least 1.8 m wide; the 1.5 m figure applies only to corridors inside a flat.
items.note: read 2026-11-14 in the actualised text with Amendment 1 (PDF on e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3884013503861753171); 1.5 m of 5.22 is the in-flat corridor, not the common corridor the generator sizes

items.note: read 2026-11-14: e-construction.gov.ua/laws_detail/3884013503861753171; no 1.05 m found; text and table 5 differ slightly, 1.35 m is the explicit minimum
